items.title: イラン大統領、抗戦姿勢崩さず－BRICS会議で結束図るも足並みに乱れ
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 主要新興国で構成するBRICS首脳会議に出席するため、インドを訪れたイランのペゼシュキアン大統領が現地で演説し、強硬な姿勢を示した。BRICS内では、加盟国間の深い亀裂も浮き彫りになっている。

アジアン・ニュース・インターナショナル（ANI）によると、ペゼシュキアン氏はニューデリーで宗教界の指導者や経済界の幹部らを前に、イラン国民は降伏しないと述べた。また、イランは米国とイスラエルの双方に同時に対抗することに成功しているとも語った。

ペゼシュキアン氏は、主要新興国からの支持を強化する狙いでインドを訪れており、中国の習近平国家主席も首脳会議に出席する見通しだ。米国による厳しい制裁を受け、半年余りにわたり攻撃にさらされているイランは、BRICSを米主導の経済・政治秩序に対抗する勢力と位置付けることに最も積極的な加盟国の一つだ。

だが、他の加盟国、特にアラブ首長国連邦（UAE）との緊張が高まっており、ニューデリーでの首脳会議で共通の立場を打ち出す取り組みは難航している。

中東各地ではここ数週間、戦闘が激化している。米国はイランによる米海軍艦艇へのミサイル攻撃に対抗し、ここ数日、イランの石油タンカーへの攻撃を強化した。

一方、イエメンでは親イラン武装組織フーシ派とサウジアラビアが支援する部隊との衝突も激しさを増している。

ペゼシュキアン大統領は週末の首脳会議に先立ち、11日にインドのモディ首相と会談した。

インド外務省の声明によると、両首脳はイラン戦争について協議した。モディ氏は対話を通じて解決すべきだとするインドの立場を改めて表明するとともに、地域の平和、航行と通商の自由、船員の安全を守る必要性を強調した。

2024年にイランと共にBRICSに加盟したUAEは、戦争中にイランによるミサイルやドローンの攻撃を繰り返し受け、エネルギーインフラや空港が被害を受けた。UAEは8月、長年の貿易相手国であるイランとの経済関係を断絶して対抗した。

items.title: Trump criticizes Smithsonian's focus on oppression
items.author: Kanishka Singh
items.creator: Kanishka Singh
items.summary: President Donald Trump criticized what he called the Smithsonian's overwhelming focus on oppression on Friday and called for a five-year exhibition on George Washington, in his latest critique of an institution he has repeatedly attacked.
items.body:
President Donald Trump criticized what he called the Smithsonian's overwhelming focus on oppression on Friday and called for a five-year exhibition on George Washington, in his latest critique of an institution he has repeatedly attacked.
The Republican leader has [USN:L4N43B04S TEXT:"denounced"] the Smithsonian for months, in what critics call part of a campaign to present U.S. history from a conservative point of view. On Tuesday, Smithsonian chief [USN:L6N4500XX TEXT:"Lonnie Bunch"] said he was retiring.
Trump said on Truth Social that "under recently ended leadership," the Smithsonian took steps "to focus attention overwhelmingly on those who have been oppressed, but there is almost no attention paid to those who triumphed over great oppression, and against great odds."
"I am calling on the Smithsonian Institution to honor the Life and Legacy of George Washington, America's Greatest Hero, with a five-year exhibition at the National Museum of American History, beginning now, and continuing through, February 22, 2032, the 300th anniversary of Washington's birth," Trump added.
Trump said he was also calling on the Smithsonian to "erect a 30-foot (9-m) 'Colossus statue'" of Washington outside the museum.
He also asked the Smithsonian to install an 11-foot (3.4-m)statue of Washington that was featured at the recent Freedom 250 Grand Prix race in the museum's Flag Hall.
The Trump administration has [USN:L1N44V03S TEXT:"previously threatened"] to cut federal funding and federal agencies' support for the Smithsonian, with Trump expressing displeasure at what he called the institution's excessive focus on how bad slavery was.
Last year, his administration [USN:L1N3U415T TEXT:"launched a review"] of some museums and his White House has accused the institution's National Museum of American History of "[USN:L4N43B04S TEXT:"thinly veiled anti-Americanism"]."
Trump has also ordered installation of signs outside the museum to reflect his administration's criticism.
Historians and civil rights advocates have denounced Trump's attacks and his accusations against the institution, saying such steps risk reversing social progress and undermine the acknowledgement of critical phases of U.S. history.
Trump says he aims to remove "anti-American ideology."
Bunch has said the White House's accusations against the National Museum of American History were unfair.
The Smithsonian is a vast museum and research complex and a premier exhibition space for U.S. history and culture, with 21 museums and galleries and the National Zoo.
Trump has [USN:L4N3YU0BK TEXT:"targeted"] U.S. cultural and historical institutions - from museums to monuments to national parks - with his declarations and orders leading to the dismantling of slavery exhibits and the restoration of Confederate statues.

items.title: Braves edge Phillies in 11-inning thriller, increase NL East lead
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Drake Baldwin lined a two-out RBI double to center field in the 11th inning to cap a two-run rally and give the Atlanta Braves a 6-5 victory over the visiting Philadelphia Phillies on Friday.
items.body:
Drake Baldwin lined a two-out RBI double to center field in the 11th inning to cap a two-run rally and give the Atlanta Braves a 6-5 victory over the visiting Philadelphia Phillies on Friday.
Atlanta, trailing 5-4, tied the game on Ha-Seong Kim's two-out single and walked it off on Baldwin's double against Brooks Raley (5-6). Didier Fuentes (7-2) was the winning pitcher.
Philadelphia had taken the lead in the top of the 11th on an RBI single by Luis Arraez.
The win allowed the Braves (87-61) to extend their National League East lead over the Phillies (82-66) to five games.
Neither starting pitcher figured in the decision.
Atlanta's Chris Sale allowed three runs -- all in the second inning -- on three hits and two walks with six strikeouts in seven innings. Philadelphia's Aaron Nola gave up two runs in 6 1/3 innings. He allowed six hits and three walks, striking out three.
Matt Olson gave the Braves a 1-0 lead in the first with an opposite-field homer, his 38th, that clipped the left field foul pole. It was his first home run since Aug. 26 against the Dodgers.
Derek Hill produced Philadelphia's offense in the second. With two outs, Edmundo Sosa singled, Bryan De La Cruz walked and J.T. Realmuto was hit by a pitch. With the bases loaded, Hill split the gap with a double that cleared the bases for a 3-1 lead.
Atlanta cut its deficit to 3-2 when Austin Riley led off the seventh with a 434-foot homer into the left-center-field stands.
The Braves tied the game in the ninth against Jonathan Bowlan. Mike Yastrzemski, who was 3-for-3, singled with one out. Pinch runner DaShawn Keirsey Jr. scored when Sean Murphy singled and center fielder Hill bobbled the ball for an error.
Both teams scored in the 10th. The Phillies scored when Justin Crawford lined the first pitch from Raisel Iglesias to center field to drive in automatic runner Bryson Stott. Atlanta tied it when automatic runner Brewer Hicklen, who pinch ran for Olson, scored on Mauricio Dubon's sacrifice fly to center.
The game's first pitch was delayed 47 minutes after a thunderstorm swept through the area.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Grammy-winning rapper Lil Durk acquitted in murder-for-hire trial
items.author: Steve Gorman
items.creator: Steve Gorman
items.summary: Grammy-winning rap artist Lil Durk was acquitted on Friday of all charges in a federal murder-for-hire case accusing him of orchestrating the revenge killing of a man shot dead in a daytime ambush in Los Angeles four years ago.
items.body:
Grammy-winning rap artist Lil Durk was acquitted on Friday of all charges in a federal murder-for-hire case accusing him of orchestrating the revenge killing of a man shot dead in a daytime ambush in Los Angeles four years ago.
Two co-defendants tried with the recording artist, whose real name is Durk Banks, were acquitted of murder-for-hire-related charges but were found guilty on charges of conspiracy to commit stalking, as well as stalking with a dangerous weapon and stalking resulting death.
Although Banks was found not guilty of all those charges, he remains in custody and faces a separate trial scheduled for October 5 on murder-related racketeering and weapons offenses, according to a spokesperson for the U.S. Attorney's Office in Los Angeles.
His two co-defendants, Deandre Dontrell Wilson and David Brian Lindsey, face trial on the same counts.
According to a 32-page federal indictment filed in the case, Banks is the ringleader of a violent criminal gang consisting of associates from his rap music label, One of the Family, that has engaged in robbery, murder and drug trafficking.
The trial that ended on Friday stemmed from a fatal shooting on August 2022 at a gasoline station near the Beverly Center shopping mall in Los Angeles that prosecutors described as a planned hit.
Banks, 33, who won the 2024 Grammy for best melodic rap performance for his hit single "All My Life," was accused of ordering, financing and masterminding the intended murder of a rival rapper Quando Rondo, born Tyquian Bowman.
According to prosecutors, Banks placed a bounty on Bowman's head as revenge for the killing two years earlier of a close friend of Banks, Dayvon "King Von" Bennett, by one of Bowman's associates in an Atlanta nightclub.
But the squad of killers who Banks allegedly sent to hunt down Bowman ended up killing Bowman's 24-year-old cousin, Saviay'a Robinson, by mistake, in a hail of gunfire.
Banks, who was arrested in October 2024 at a Florida airport after five other suspects were charged in the case, has pleaded not guilty to all charges.
Defense lawyers have asserted that Banks had nothing to do with the plot, maintaining that it was a former personal assistant who ordered the hit to impress his boss, the Los Angeles City News Service reported in its account of the trial.
The ex-assistant and two other Banks associates originally indicted with the rapper reached plea deals in the case and testified for the prosecution, according to CNS.
Banks' acquittal set off a celebration by the rap artist's supporters outside the downtown Los Angeles federal courthouse where the trial was held.

items.title: Guardians boost playoff hopes with 3-run ninth vs. Twins
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Angel Martinez went 2-for-4 with a two-run home run, and the Cleveland Guardians scored three runs in the top of the ninth inning to secure a 5-2 win over the Minnesota Twins on Friday night in Minneapolis.
items.body:
Angel Martinez went 2-for-4 with a two-run home run, and the Cleveland Guardians scored three runs in the top of the ninth inning to secure a 5-2 win over the Minnesota Twins on Friday night in Minneapolis.
Brayan Rocchio finished 1-for-3 with a double and two RBIs for Cleveland (75-73) in the opener of the three-game series. Travis Bazzana went 2-for-2 and scored twice for the Guardians, who hold a two-game lead over the Toronto Blue Jays for the American League's third and final wild-card spot.
Royce Lewis and Kaelen Culpepper tallied one RBI apiece for Minnesota (69-78), which trails Cleveland by 5 1/2 games for the final AL wild-card spot.
Guardians reliever Hunter Gaddis (4-3) pitched 1 1/3 innings of scoreless relief.
Twins reliever Yoendrys Gomez (2-3) gave up three runs on two hits in one-third of an inning.
Cade Smith earned his 36th save for the Guardians with a scoreless ninth.
The score was 2-all when Cleveland broke through in the ninth. Bazzana walked, moved to third on Martinez's double and scored the go-ahead run on a wild pitch by Gomez. Rocchio increased the lead to 5-2 moments later with a two-run double to center.
The Twins opened the scoring in the second. Kody Clemens hit a one-out single to center, and Lewis delivered in the next at-bat with an RBI double to left.
The sequence marked Lewis' 52nd RBI of the season, matching a career high that he set in 2023 and equaled in 2025.
Twins starter Taj Bradley delivered a strong performance with six scoreless innings, but the Guardians wasted no time taking advantage of the bullpen in the top of the seventh.
Bazzana led off the inning with a hard-hit single to center. Martinez stepped to the plate two batters later, swung at a low first-pitch fastball and crushed a two-run homer 445 feet over the wall in left-center field.
The monster blast gave the Guardians a 2-1 lead and marked the 15th home run of the season for Martinez.
Minnesota evened the score in the bottom of the seventh. Culpepper lifted a two-out single just above a leaping Jose Ramirez at third base, and Austin Martin sprinted from second base to score with a headfirst slide.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Shelton advances to US Open final for Zverev showdown
items.author: Shrivathsa Sridhar
items.creator: Shrivathsa Sridhar
items.summary: Ben Shelton defeated compatriot Frances Tiafoe 4-6 6-3 6-3 7-5 in an electric U.S. Open semi-final on Friday to secure a title clash with Alexander Zverev and move closer to ending a 23-year American wait for a men's singles Grand Slam champion.
items.body:
Ben Shelton defeated compatriot Frances Tiafoe 4-6 6-3 6-3 7-5 in an electric U.S. Open semi-final on Friday to secure a title clash with Alexander Zverev and move closer to ending a 23-year American wait for a men's singles Grand Slam champion.
Zverev [USN:L1N4530XD TEXT:"booked his place"] in Sunday's final by fighting past unseeded Russian Karen Khachanov 6-3 7-6(7) 7-6(6) earlier in the day to close in on a second major title.
Victory sent the German top seed into his second final in New York after his runner-up finish in 2020 to Dominic Thiem.
Shelton, the big-hitting 23-year-old, now stands one victory away from becoming the first American man to win a major singles title since Andy Roddick hoisted the trophy at Flushing Meadows in 2003.
With the semi-final line-up having already ensured a Black American man would reach the final, Shelton's win made him the first to do so in New York since Arthur Ashe in 1972, and at any of the majors since MaliVai Washington at Wimbledon in 1996.
French Open champion Zverev was [USN:L1N4530YC TEXT:"pushed to five sets"] in each of his opening two rounds, but has now won four straight matches without dropping a set to charge into his third consecutive major final and stand in Shelton's path.
"I'm going for it," Shelton said. "I'm going to leave it all on the court. I hope you guys come and back me, let's do this for the U.S.
"It's a lot of emotion. My dad, my mom have sacrificed a lot for me to be in this position today. My dad lost his mom earlier this year and she's the reason he was able to play tennis.
"Without her there's no Ben Shelton standing here today. This one is for her."
POIGNANT START TO EVENING On a poignant evening that began with commemorations marking the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks, Tiafoe powered ahead 5-4 when Shelton produced a double fault, before raising the roof on the main showcourt with a hold to bag the first set.
"It's a difficult day to be out here playing," Shelton said.
"My thoughts and prayers are going out to all the families who are impacted by 9/11. This is one of the greatest cities in the world and one of the biggest tragedies. But yeah, thoughts and prayers to everyone involved and affected."
Tiafoe continued to target his opponent's relatively weaker backhand in the second set but Shelton dialled up the intensity to draw level and broke in the fifth game of the third set to take a commanding lead.
With his booming left-handed serve and his defence proving impenetrable in the high-octane fourth set, eighth seed Shelton heaped the pressure on late and moved into his maiden major final after a double fault by Tiafoe.
"Frances, he's like a big brother to me," Shelton added.
"Every time we get to take this court together, Arthur Ashe Stadium, and play each other is super special. But this is where we want to be at the tail end ... this is our favourite tournament, our favourite court in the world.
"To be able to light it up in front of you guys is the best feeling there is."
Top seeds Katerina Siniakova and Taylor Townsend earlier secured a [USN:L6N45316D TEXT:"team career Grand Slam"] with a 5-7 6-0 6-2 victory over American wildcards Ashlyn Krueger and Robin Montgomery in the women's doubles final.
The action will resume on Saturday when defending champion Aryna Sabalenka of Belarus faces incoming world number one Elena Rybakina of Kazakhstan in the [USN:L4N45319U TEXT:"women's singles final"].

items.title: King Oyo, once world's youngest monarch, to be buried in western Uganda
items.author: Elias Biryabarema
items.creator: Elias Biryabarema
items.summary: Uganda's Tooro Kingdom prepared on Saturday to bury its late king, Oyo Nyimba, long the world's youngest monarch, following days of a bitter succession battle within the royal family.
items.body:
Uganda's Tooro Kingdom prepared on Saturday to bury its late king, Oyo Nyimba, long the world's youngest monarch, following days of a [USN:L6N4520G9 TEXT:"bitter succession battle"] within the royal family.
Royal guards clad in orange tunics and beating wooden sticks led the hearse carrying Oyo's casket in a solemn procession through the streets of the kingdom's capital, Fort Portal.
King Oyo Nyimba Kabamba Iguru Rukidi IV made global headlines in 1995 when he took the throne at age 3. Images of the toddler king donning a crown and royal robes sparked curiosity and adoration around the world.
He [USN:L1N44P087 TEXT:"died"] last month at 34 in the United States, where he was receiving treatment for cancer.
His casket, draped in the blue-and-yellow Tooro flag, was driven from the royal palace to St. John's Cathedral in the western city of Fort Portal for a ceremony before hundreds of mourners, including senior Ugandan government officials.
Uganda is led by an elected head of state but retains several kingdoms that pre-date the British colonial era and are seen as bulwarks of traditional identity and heritage.
SUCCESSION BATTLE THREATENED TO DELAY BURIAL After the cathedral service, Oyo will be buried at the site of the royal tombs. The Omusuna, the traditional chief priest charged with burying Tooro's monarchs, will guide the incoming king in the custom of casting nine coffee berries into the grave.
Whether the new king would be in place to perform that mandatory rite had been in doubt until late on Friday.
A committee consisting of members of the royal clan announced on Wednesday it had [USN:L8N45123S TEXT:"chosen Oyo's cousin"], Edward Rukidi Kijanangoma, a news anchor and editor at state broadcaster UBC, as king.
But Oyo's immediate family said his hitherto unknown son should succeed him, as called for in the late king's will. Oyo never married and was not known to have any children until the kingdom's prime minister said he had a son in the August 27 statement announcing his death.
Supporters of Kijanangoma's succession say Oyo's family has not been able to produce basic information about the purported son.
A source with knowledge of crisis talks over the matter said Ugandan authorities had successfully pushed through Kijanangoma's succession on Friday.
A government spokesperson could not be reached for comment. The Ugandan military said it had beefed up security in the area to prevent any trouble.
LATE KING WAS CHAMPION OF FIGHT AGAINST HIV, FRIEND OF GADDAFI Oyo himself took the throne after a protracted succession battle that finished in court.
He went on to become a U.N. goodwill ambassador who championed the fight against HIV and AIDS. He also cultivated close ties with former Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi, whom he named a special adviser to the monarch. Gaddafi donated money towards refurbishment of the royal palace.
"We are sending a revered and loved leader, an icon and we want to make sure the moment, the spectacle and rituals fit his stature," Vincent Mugume, the kingdom's spokesperson, told Reuters.
The 56-year-old Kijanangoma, who maintained a lower profile as the succession battle played out, has been praised by those who know him for his humility.
"Someone you don't get to find in scandals, someone that is so quiet," Mary Tumwikirize, a colleague of Kijanangoma's at UBC, said in a television interview. "It took me a very long time to actually know that he was a prince."
Besides the throne, the new king will inherit a considerable royal estate including swathes of land and sizeable cash payouts from the central government.

items.title: India-China relations, from conflict to cautious thaw
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chinese President Xi Jinping will hold talks on Saturday on the sidelines of the BRICS summit in New Delhi.
items.body:
Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chinese President Xi Jinping [USN:L1N4520BQ TEXT:"will hold talks"] on Saturday on the sidelines of the BRICS summit in New Delhi.
Here is a look at how ties between the Asian giants have evolved from a deadly 2020 border clash to a more stable footing today, as the Chinese leader makes his first visit to India in seven years.
WHAT HAPPENED IN 2020? Indian and Chinese troops engaged in [USN:L1N3M10AB TEXT:"hand-to-hand combat"] in Galwan Valley in the Indian territory of Ladakh in the western Himalayas — their first deadly military confrontation since 1975 — after Indian soldiers set fire to two tents and observation towers they said were built on their side of the disputed border.
At least 20 Indian and four Chinese soldiers were killed in the fighting in Galwan.
The nuclear-armed neighbours share a roughly 3,800-km (2,400-mile), largely undemarcated and disputed border in the Himalayas.
HOW DID THE GOVERNMENTS RESPOND? New Delhi [USN:L4N3ZY0YN TEXT:"increased scrutiny"] of Chinese investments, widened vetting of business visas for Chinese citizens, [USN:L4N2UQ1M1 TEXT:"banned"] popular Chinese mobile apps, and severed direct passenger air links.
Beijing said the consensus between the countries had been seriously violated, and [USN:K7N36E01I TEXT:"tightened curbs"] on people-to-people exchanges, including the travel of journalists and businesspeople.
WHEN DID DISENGAGEMENT HAPPEN? The neighbours [USN:L4N3LX0LS TEXT:"reached a disengagement pact "]in October 2024, by which point they had both pulled back troops from five locations where they had been facing off.
The pact also entailed returning to the situation in 2020 by pulling back troops from the remaining two locations — a condition fulfilled by December that year.
WHAT IS THE SITUATION NOW? Trade and business ties have improved, with New Delhi [USN:L1N3UB056 TEXT:"resuming direct flights"] to China, cutting red tape to [USN:L1N3XI06C TEXT:"speed approval"] of business visas for Chinese professionals, and [USN:L6N40I08D TEXT:"easing "][USN:L6N40I08D TEXT:"curbs"] on buying Chinese equipment.
China was the South Asian nation's [USN:L6N43O08T TEXT:"largest source of imports"] in fiscal year 2025/26, worth $132 billion, including more than 100 products deemed critical to Indian factories.
Along the frontier, though, both countries continue to maintain substantial [USN:L1N44M0IJ TEXT:"military deployments."]
WHAT TENSIONS REMAIN? Besides [USN:L6N4490OG TEXT:"intermittent tension"] on the frontier, territorial disputes often flare over India's northeastern state of Arunachal Pradesh, which Beijing calls Zangnan and considers a part of southern Tibet.
China's role in India's military conflict last year with arch-rival Pakistan has also complicated ties. Although Beijing was not directly involved, Pakistan [USN:L6N3TC0L0 TEXT:"relied heavily"] on Chinese-made fighter jets and missiles during the four-day fighting.
Trade ties also remain fragile, with industry executives highlighting visa delays and bottlenecks in procuring Chinese equipment and components critical in areas such as electronics and infrastructure development.
India is also wary of Chinese investment in industries it considers sensitive for national security such as finance, defence and telecom.

items.title: Brics Summit 2026: Xi Jinping lands in Delhi, PM Modi to host him for talks
items.author: Press Trust of India
items.summary: The Chinese president's India visit comes nearly seven years after his last trip, with the two leaders expected to discuss bilateral ties, cooperation and differences on the sidelines of the summit ...
items.body: Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in the national capital on Saturday for a two-day visit to attend the BRICS Summit, marking his first trip to India in seven years -- a step that is expected to boost the overall trajectory of bilateral relations. Prime Minister Narendra Modi will host President Xi for bilateral talks on Saturday evening. The Chinese leader was received at the Delhi airport by Union Minister Jitin Prasada, as cultural artistes performed traditional dances to welcome Xi. People familiar with the matter said the visit presents a key opportunity to further normalise relations that came under severe strain following the eastern Ladakh military standoff. Xi's visit to India comes on the heels of several high-level exchanges, including the Special Representative dialogue in Beijing between National Security Advisor Ajit Doval and Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi, even as concerns linger over aggressive Chinese military posturing along the Arunachal Pradesh sector. The Chinese leader is accompanied by a high-level delegation comprising government officials and top business leaders. Both sides have rolled out a series of confidence-building measures over the past year to repair ties frayed by the more than four-and-a-half-year military standoff in eastern Ladakh. In their talks, Modi and Xi are expected to review the overall situation along the Line of Actual Control (LAC) and explore further ways to normalise bilateral relations, including through expanded trade and investment ties, people familiar with the matter said. The meeting is slated to take place at 6 pm. Modi and Xi held wide-ranging talks on August 31 last year on the margins of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit in the Chinese city of Tianjin. In the last few months, the two sides have taken a series of measures to rebuild their relationship after it came under severe strain following the deadly Galwan Valley clashes in 2020. NSA Doval held Special Representative (SR) talks with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang late last month that focused on delimitation of the frontier and sustaining work on trans-boundary cooperation as well as maintaining peace along the LAC. Both Doval and Wang are the designated SRs for the boundary talks mechanism, which was established in 2003 to comprehensively address the dispute over the India-China border spanning 3,488 km.

items.title: ＭＬＢ＝今永が2年ぶり10勝、鈴木3安打　岡本31号
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１１日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）は１１日、各地で試合を行い、カブスの今永昇太投手はパイレーツ戦に先発し、６回を５安打２失点、２四球、４三振で１０勝目（１０敗）を挙げた。２桁勝利は２０２４年以来２年ぶり。

鈴木誠也外野手は「２番・右翼」で先発出場し、５打数３安打１打点、３得点。四回に右前適時打、六回には三塁打を放った。カブスは１２─２で勝ち、連敗を４で止めた。

ブルージェイズの岡本和真内野手は本拠地でのオリオールズ戦に「６番・三塁」で先発出場し、３１号ソロを含む４打数２安打１打点、１三振だった。ブルージェイズは４─７で敗れた。

エンゼルスの菊池雄星投手は敵地でのナショナルズ戦に先発し、４回を３安打１失点、４四球、５三振で勝敗は付かなかった。チームは３─４で逆転負けした。

items.title: Boca Juniors golea con doblete de paraguayo Romero y tanto de ecuatoriano Valencia en liga argentina
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Un doblete del paraguayo Ángel Romero y otro tanto del ecuatoriano Enner Valencia le dieron a Boca Juniors el triunfo por 3-1 el viernes ante Central Córdoba en la novena jornada del torneo Clausura.
items.body:
Un doblete del paraguayo Ángel Romero y otro tanto del ecuatoriano Enner Valencia le dieron a Boca Juniors el triunfo por 3-1 el viernes ante Central Córdoba en la novena jornada del torneo Clausura.
"Me sentí muy bien, hace tiempo que no jugaba de titular, pero siempre trabajando para aprovechar la oportunidad. Fue una victoria importante”, dijo Romero a la televisión local.
En el partido disputado en el estadio La Bombonera, Boca Juniors abrió el marcador al minuto cinco por intermedio de Romero luego de un centro del colombiano Sebastián Villa.
El segundo gol del popular conjunto argentino llegó a los 11 minutos por intermedio de Valencia tras un centro bajo de Dylan Gorosito desde el sector derecho.
En el segundo tiempo, Romero convirtió el tercer gol para Boca a los 56 minutos con un potente remate de larga distancia.
Central Córdoba descontó a los 90 minutos por intermedio de Martín Cuitiño.
“Nos llevamos tres puntos ante nuestra gente, y a medida que pasan los partidos me estoy adaptando a Boca. Esperemos que sea el primer gol de muchos", dijo Valencia tras su primer gol en el “Xeneize”.
Por su parte, en el estadio Coloso-Marcelo Bielsa de la ciudad de Rosario en la provincia de Santa Fe, Newell's Old Boys rescató un agónico empate por 1-1 como local ante Vélez Sarsfield.
Vélez abrió el marcador a los 27 minutos con un tanto del paraguayo Ronaldo Martínez, mientras que Newell's igualó a los 93 a través del ingresado Alan Soñora.
El arquero de Vélez, Tomás Marchiori, atajó un penal a Santiago Solari a los 43 minutos, tras una mano de Simón Escobar dentro del área.
En otro partido del viernes, Defensa y Justicia ganó por 2-0 como local a Gimnasia y Esgrima de Mendoza con goles de Leandro Fernández y David Barbona.

items.title: 北朝鮮、短距離弾道ミサイルを東側海域へ数発発射　250キロ飛行
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Heekyong Yang

[ソウル １２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Heekyong Yang

[ソウル １２日 ロイター] - 韓国軍合同参謀本部は１２日、北朝鮮が元山地域から東側の海域に向けて短距離弾道ミサイルを数発発射したと発表した。

ミサイルは午前５時２０分（日本時間同）ごろから発射され、約２５０キロ飛行。韓国と米国の当局がミサイルについて詳細な分析を行っているという。

合同参謀本部によると、韓国と米国の情報当局は発射の着手からその動向を追跡し、情報を共有していたほか、弾道ミサイルに関する情報は日本にも共有された。

声明で「韓国軍は北朝鮮の動向を注視しており、米国との合同防衛態勢の下、いかなる挑発に対しても圧倒的に対応する能力と態勢を維持している」と述べた。

韓国大統領府によると、発射を受け、大統領府国家安保室は国防省、合同参謀本部およびその他の関係機関を交えた緊急安全保障会議を招集した。

大統領府はまた、弾道ミサイルの発射は国連安全保障理事会決議に対する重大な違反であるとして、北朝鮮に直ちに発射を停止するよう強く求めた。

これとは別に、米太平洋軍は、発射を把握しており、同盟国やパートナー国と緊密に協議していると表明。現在の評価に基づけば、今回の発射は米国の要員、領土、同盟国に対して差し迫った脅威をもたらすものではないとし、Ｘに「米国は米本土およびこの地域の同盟国の防衛に引き続きコミットしている」と投稿した。

日米韓の３カ国は１１日まで共同訓練を実施していた。

items.title: Brewers demolish Reds 20-0, wrap up postseason berth
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Garrett Mitchell hit a grand slam, William Contreras homered and drove in six runs, and Dustin May tossed six innings of two-hit ball as the Milwaukee Brewers routed the visiting Cincinnati Reds 20-0 on Friday night to clinch their eighth postseason berth in nine seasons.
items.body:
Garrett Mitchell hit a grand slam, William Contreras homered and drove in six runs, and Dustin May tossed six innings of two-hit ball as the Milwaukee Brewers routed the visiting Cincinnati Reds 20-0 on Friday night to clinch their eighth postseason berth in nine seasons.
The Brewers fell short of the biggest shutout in modern major league history, a record they tied on Aug. 18 by trouncing the Seattle Mariners 22-0.
May (7-9), acquired at the trade deadline from the St. Louis Cardinals, allowed singles in the first and fourth innings, both to Sal Stewart. May struck out six and walked one in an 84-pitch outing to improve to 2-2 with Milwaukee.
Rookie Garrett Stallings pitched the final three innings for his first save.
Mitchell's 10th homer of the year and first career grand slam capped an eight-run fifth that put the Brewers up 17-0. Brice Turang (3-for-3, four RBIs) and Jake Bauers homered during a six-run second when Milwaukee went in front 8-0.
Contreras belted a three-run homer in the eighth off catcher Jose Trevino, who pitched the final two innings for the Reds.
Milwaukee (92-56) pounded out a season-high 23 hits and won its fourth straight to maintain a 10-game lead in the National League Central over the Chicago Cubs (82-66), who won earlier Friday. The Brewers, bidding for their fourth consecutive division title, are 1 1/2 games ahead of the Los Angeles Dodgers for the best overall record in the majors.
The Brewers jumped on Andrew Abbott (6-11) for two runs in the first and six in the second, ending his outing after he allowed nine hits on 43 pitches. Cincinnati (69-78) has lost four straight.
Contreras (sacrifice fly) and Andrew Vaughn (double) had the RBIs in the first inning.
Cooper Pratt and Mitchell opened the second with consecutive singles. Jackson Chourio's one-out ground-rule double scored Pratt to make it 3-0. Turang then lined a 1-2 pitch 382 feet to right-center for a three-run homer. Vaughn singled with two outs, and Bauers followed with a 412-foot shot to center.
Milwaukee added a run the fourth when Turang drew a leadoff walk and scored when Bauers' two-out single was misplayed for an outfield error.
Rookie Luis Lara kept the Reds off the board in the fifth with a sensational leaping grab above the right field wall on Eugenio Suarez's potential homer.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Orioles top Blue Jays, gain ground in wild-card chase
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Dylan Beavers socked a solo home run and had three RBIs on Friday as the visiting Baltimore Orioles defeated the Toronto Blue Jays 7-4 to pick up a crucial game in the playoff chase.
items.body:
Dylan Beavers socked a solo home run and had three RBIs on Friday as the visiting Baltimore Orioles defeated the Toronto Blue Jays 7-4 to pick up a crucial game in the playoff chase.
Coby Mayo added a solo blast and Christian Encarnacion-Strand rapped out three hits for the Orioles in the opener of a three-game series.
The Orioles (72-76) moved within one game of the Blue Jays (73-75) in the tight race for the third and final American League wild-card spot. The Cleveland Guardians (75-73), the current occupier of that slot, sit two games in front of Toronto and three games ahead of Baltimore after beating the Minnesota Twins 5-2 on Friday.
Toronto's Brett Bateman hit his first major league homer, a two-run shot in the ninth against Alex Hoppe. After two singles followed, Rico Garcia got the final out to earn his eighth save.
Kazuma Okamoto added a solo homer and double for the Blue Jays.
The Orioles and Blue Jays are 4-4 in their season series with five games remaining between the teams. The winner of the season series would hold the tiebreaker for a playoff spot should it be needed.
Beavers led off the game when he drove a homer to right against Max Scherzer (2-8) on an 0-1 cutter.
Orioles starter Chris Bassitt (7-5), a former Blue Jay, survived a single and two walks in the home first. The rally was blunted when catcher Samuel Basallo picked off Vladimir Guerrero Jr. at first for the second out.
The Orioles exploded for five runs in the second. Gunnar Henderson, Basallo and Encarnacion-Strand loaded the bases with no outs thanks to successive singles. Heston Kjerstad stroked an RBI single to right, Colton Cowser hit a two-run double to left and Beavers hit a two-run single to right before an out was recorded.
Bassitt pitched around a bases-loaded jam after a single, an error and a walk in the third.
Okamoto led off the Toronto fourth with a homer to right on a 1-0 sinker.
Scherzer completed five innings, allowing six runs, seven hits and one walk with three strikeouts.
Bassitt was replaced by Josh Walker after Toronto opened the sixth with a bloop single to left by Nathan Lukes and a ringing double to left by Okamoto. Andres Gimenez's one-out groundout to second off Josh Walker scored the only run of the inning.
Bassitt allowed two runs, six hits and three walks with five strikeouts in five-plus innings.
Mayo clubbed Braydon Fisher's 1-2 slider for a homer to left with two outs in the seventh.
Bateman homered to right after Ernie Clement blooped a two-out double to right in the ninth.
--Field Level Media

２０２６会計年度（２５年１０月─２６年９月）の８月までの累計財政赤字は１兆９７００億ドルと、前年同期とほぼ変わらない水準となっている。２５会計年度の赤字は通期では１兆７７５０億ドルだった。

８月単月の歳出（調整前）は２４％減の５２７０億ドル。連邦債務の利払いが１４０億ドル減少した。

調整前の歳入は１６０億ドル（５％）増の３６００億ドルとなった。これには１２８億４０００万ドルの関税純収入が含まれている。

items.title: Carlos Rodon, Yankees beat Mets on 25th anniversary of 9/11
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Carlos Rodon pitched 6 1/3 sharp innings and the host New York Yankees homered twice off rookie Nolan McLean in a 6-4 victory over the New York Mets on Friday night.
items.body:
Carlos Rodon pitched 6 1/3 sharp innings and the host New York Yankees homered twice off rookie Nolan McLean in a 6-4 victory over the New York Mets on Friday night.
The Yankees (85-62) won for the ninth time in 12 games and 17th time in 24 games while moving closer to clinching their ninth postseason spot in the past 10 seasons.
Cody Bellinger hit a tiebreaking three-run homer off McLean (11-9) in the second inning and Ben Rice added a leadoff blast in the fifth as the Yankees finished with 13 hits.
Rookie Spencer Jones contributed an RBI single when the Yankees loaded the bases in the first and Ryan McMahon chipped in an RBI single in the eighth.
In his longest start of a season interrupted by a pair of stints on the injured list with elbow injuries, Rodon (6-3) allowed two runs (one earned) on three hits. He struck out Juan Soto twice and finished with eight strikeouts overall while issuing one walk.
Rodon exited to a nice ovation from the sellout crowd after allowing a single to rookie Carson Benge. Paul Blackburn loaded the bases and allowed an RBI single to rookie A.J. Ewing but Brent Headrick snagged Francisco Lindor's liner to escape a bases-loaded jam in the seventh.
Headrick loaded the bases and was charged with a run in the eighth when Marcus Semien lifted a sacrifice fly off David Bednar. Bednar also allowed
Ewing's homer to open the ninth before securing his 33rd save by retiring Soto on a 3-6-3 double play.
There was a pregame ceremony to commemorate the 25th anniversary of the Sept. 11 terrorist attacks, featuring various members of the team, including former captain Derek Jeter, Mariano Rivera and former manager Joe Torre.
McLean allowed five runs and a career-high 10 hits in five innings. The right-hander struck out five, walked one and took his first loss in five starts as the Mets (68-79) had a four-game win streak snapped.
McLean also allowed three or more earned runs for the third time in his past 18 starts and failed to complete six innings for the second time in his past 15 outings.
After Christopher Morel delivered a game-tying RBI groundout in the second, Anthony Volpe and Rice singled with two outs before Bellinger hit a full-count curveball into the right field seats for his 14th homer.
Rice extended the lead to 5-1 when he lifted McLean's first-pitch sinker into the left field seats for his 37th homer.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Kyle Tucker's slam carries Dodgers past Marlins for 8th straight win
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Kyle Tucker went 3-for-3 with a grand slam and a season-high five RBIs, leading the Los Angeles Dodgers to their eighth straight win, a 6-2 victory over the host Miami Marlins on Friday.
items.body:
Kyle Tucker went 3-for-3 with a grand slam and a season-high five RBIs, leading the Los Angeles Dodgers to their eighth straight win, a 6-2 victory over the host Miami Marlins on Friday.
Tucker finished a double shy of the cycle.
Los Angeles starter Blake Snell (4-1) struck out eight in 5 2/3 innings. He allowed one run on four hits and two walks, and he was removed after his pitch count reached 101.
The Dodgers, who lead the National League West with a 90-57 record, played without injured power hitters Shohei Ohtani (right biceps) and Freddie Freeman (right knee).
Miami (72-76) lost for the seventh time in eight games.
Ryan Gusto (1-5) took a tough-luck defeat after producing a quality start. He lasted six innings and held the Dodgers to two runs on five hits and three walks. He fanned three.
Miami's offense was led by Otto Lopez, who went 4-for-5. Javier Sanoja tripled, singled and scored twice.
Los Angeles opened the scoring in the third inning. Tommy Edman drew a leadoff walk, advanced on Max Muncy's single and scored on Tucker's sacrifice fly.
The Dodgers made it 2-0 in the sixth as Tucker tripled off the wall in right with one out and scored on Will Smith's bloop single to right.
Miami got on the board in the sixth. Sanoja singled off Snell, stole second and scored on Agustin Ramirez's double off reliever Evan Phillips. Ramirez fouled off six pitches before lining a two-bagger to the gap in right-center.
With two outs and no one on in the seventh, Edman drew a walk from Victor Vodnik. Muncy singled and Mookie Betts walked to load the bases. Miami brought in reliever Cade Gibson, whose third pitch was an 80 mph sweeper that Tucker pulled over the right field fence for his sixth career grand slam.
Tucker hadn't hit a grand slam since 2023.
Miami cut its deficit to 6-2 in the eighth when Sanoja tripled and scored on Owen Caissie's sacrifice fly.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Royals make early lead hold, take series opener in Boston
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Kansas City scored three runs over the first three innings and let its pitching do the rest as the Royals held on to beat the host Boston Red Sox 3-2 in their three-game series opener on Friday night.
items.body:
Kansas City scored three runs over the first three innings and let its pitching do the rest as the Royals held on to beat the host Boston Red Sox 3-2 in their three-game series opener on Friday night.
Carter Jensen (two doubles) went 2-for 5 with an RBI and Salvador Perez went 2-for-4 with an RBI to lead the Royals (66-82), who were just 3-7 in their previous 10 games.
Seth Lugo (7-8) scattered seven hits and struck out seven across five innings of two-run ball for the victory. Steven Cruz finished off his seventh save with a 1-2-3 ninth.
Mickey Gasper hit his ninth homer of the season and Wilyer Abreu went 2-for-4 with an RBI double for the Red Sox (80-68), who were held to just one hit over the final four innings. They have lost three straight since a five-game winning streak.
The Royals jumped ahead with a pair of first-inning hits off Sonny Gray (17-5), who went six frames and allowed three runs on six hits. After Jensen crushed a leadoff double off the wall in deep center field, Perez knocked a two-out RBI single inside the third base line to open the scoring.
After Gray responded with a 1-2-3 second, Isaac Collins and Jensen started the third with back-to-back doubles, extending Kansas City's lead to 2-0. Jensen's double high off the Green Monster brought in the run. Two batters later, Vinnie Pasquantino's single through the right side made it a three-run game before a double play ended the inning.
The Red Sox wasted two singles in each of the first two innings and had baserunners in the first four, with Lugo posting inning-ending strikeouts in two of them. Gasper's one-out solo shot into the right-center field bullpen got the home team on the scoreboard in the fifth.
After Adley Rutschman walked immediately following the homer, Abreu's RBI double high off the Monster brought the hosts within 3-2. Lugo stopped the threat there, striking out back-to-back batters.
Nolan Hoffman and Connor Thomas relieved Lugo with back-to-back 1-2-3 innings, and Nate Pearson stranded Trevor Story on second base following a one-out double in the eighth. Story eluded second baseman Michael Massey's tag to reach safely.
The Royals had a chance to extend their lead after Perez and Massey started the eighth with back-to-back singles, with Rutschman catching pinch runner Tyler Tolbert stealing second in between. Jovani Moran stranded two to end the inning before striking out two in the ninth.
--Field Level Media

items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： トランプ米大統領は、中国の自動車メーカーによる米国内での電気自動車（EV）製造について、米国人労働者による生産を条件に認める可能性を示唆した。一方、中国からの輸入車を事実上締め出している措置は維持するとも表明した。

トランプ氏はFOXニュースとのインタビューで、中国車の輸入を認めるとの見方を否定。習近平国家主席に言及し、「われわれは彼の国の車が米国に入ることを認めていないし、これまで一度も認めたことはない」と述べ、そうでなければ米国の自動車市場は「席巻される」と付け加えた。

「中国が米国に進出して自動車工場を開設したいのであれば、私は構わない。日本もそうしている。ただし、米国人を雇うことが条件だ」と述べた。「重要なのは、米国人を雇い、米国人の力を活用することだ」と語った。

さらに、「私が望まないのは、メキシコで安く生産し、国境を越えて米国に輸出することだ」と述べ、「そんなことはさせない」と話した。

比亜迪（BYD）や吉利汽車などが手がける低価格で先進技術を搭載した中国製EVは、世界の市場で急速にシェアを伸ばしている。カナダとメキシコにも進出しており、近く米市場への足がかりを築こうとする可能性があるとの懸念が米自動車メーカー幹部の間で強まっている。

現在、中国車は高関税に加え、安全保障上の理由から米商務省が導入した規制により、米市場から事実上締め出されている。

トランプ氏のコメントは、ワシントンで予定されている習主席との首脳会談を数週間後に控える中で出たものだが、以前にも同様の発言をしている。

トランプ大統領は1月、デトロイト・エコノミック・クラブでの演説で、中国メーカーによる米国内での自動車生産を容認する可能性を示唆し、「中国企業に進出させればいい」と述べていた。

items.title: Nationals' late rally upends Angels, halts 7-game slide
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Jorbit Vivas hit a tiebreaking two-run double to cap a three-run eighth inning as the Washington Nationals snapped a seven-game losing streak with a 4-3 comeback victory over the visiting Los Angeles Angels in the opener of a three-game series Friday night.
items.body:
Jorbit Vivas hit a tiebreaking two-run double to cap a three-run eighth inning as the Washington Nationals snapped a seven-game losing streak with a 4-3 comeback victory over the visiting Los Angeles Angels in the opener of a three-game series Friday night.
CJ Abrams had two hits and a run and James Wood went 1-for-3 with an RBI single and a walk for Washington (68-81). Clayton Beeter (6-5) tossed a scoreless eighth and Erik Tolman earned his second save despite allowing a run.
Mike Trout hit a home run and Christian Moore doubled and had two hits and two RBIs for Los Angeles (56-91), which finished with just four hits. Samy Natera Jr. (1-2) allowed three runs on three hits and a walk in one inning for the Angels, who had won their previous two games.
Los Angeles took a 1-0 lead in the first on Trout's 21st home run, a 416-foot drive to left-center. It snapped a 27-game homerless drought, one shy of his career high. It was also his 425th homer, moving him past Edwin Encarnacion into 54th place on the all-time list.
Washington tied it in the fourth when Harry Ford walked, stole second and scored on Wood's two-out single to left.
The Angels regained the lead in the seventh. Vaughn Grissom and Moises Ballesteros opened the inning with walks and Moore, after twice failing to move them along with a sacrifice bunt, singled to left on a 3-2 pitch to drive in Grissom for a 2-1 lead.
The Nationals parlayed a leadoff walk by Brady House with three hits and a sacrifice fly to score three times in the eighth to go ahead 4-2.
House correctly challenged a strike three call and worked a walk to open the inning. Abrams followed with a single, then Dylan Crews loaded the bases with a perfect bunt single up the third base line. After House was thrown out at home on a grounder hit by Yohandy Morales, pinch hitter Andrew Pinckney tied it at 2-2 with a sacrifice fly. After Morales stole second, Vivas followed with a two-run double into the right field corner to give the Nationals their first lead.
The Angels came within about five feet of tying the game in the ninth when Moore drilled a two-out double off the top of the fence in right-center, driving in Oswald Peraza, who had walked. Tolman then got pinch hitter Kyren Paris to fly out to left to end the game.
--Field Level Media

items.title: The evolution of BRICS and its challenges today
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Leaders of the BRICS group of nations will meet on Saturday in the Indian capital of New Delhi for their annual summit, amid mounting geopolitical tension, disruptions in energy markets, shipping, and global trade.
items.body:
Leaders of the BRICS group of nations will meet on Saturday in the Indian capital of New Delhi for their [USN:L1N4520BS TEXT:"annual summit"], amid mounting geopolitical tension, disruptions in energy markets, shipping, and global trade.
Here is a look at the bloc's history, and the challenges it faces today.
WHAT IS BRICS? The acronym BRIC was coined by Goldman Sachs Chief Economist Jim O'Neill in 2001, in a research paper highlighting the growth potential of Brazil, Russia, India, and China, but it was not until 2009 that the countries came together as a bloc.
South Africa joined them in 2011, creating BRICS as it is known today.
The grouping [USN:L1N3A50HL TEXT:"expanded"] in 2024, when Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran and UAE became members, and in 2025, when Indonesia joined.
Saudi Arabia has also been invited to be part of the bloc but has not formally accepted the invitation.
WHY WAS IT FORMED? BRICS was set up to challenge a world order dominated by the United States and its Western allies.
Together, its members account for more than 40% of the world's population and almost a quarter of the global economy.
The grouping today focuses on political and security cooperation, economic and financial cooperation, and people-to-people exchanges, according to the BRICS website set up by India during its presidency this year.
Members meet annually, with the chairmanship rotating among them.
WHAT HAS IT ACHIEVED? BRICS' biggest achievement is the multilateral New Development Bank, established in 2015 to finance infrastructure and sustainable development projects in emerging markets.
The bank has approved 139 projects worth nearly $43 billion, according to its website, but suspended new transactions in Russia in the face of sanctions.
In addition, a BRICS Pay System is being set up, with the aim of linking members' fast payment systems to enable cross-border settlements without relying on dollar-based banks.
Members are also [USN:L1N44806L TEXT:"exploring linking"] their central bank digital currencies and are increasingly [USN:L1N45008Y TEXT:"settling trade"] in national currencies as they [USN:L8N4381GB TEXT:"pursue "][USN:L8N4381GB TEXT:"alternatives"] to dollar-based payment systems.
WHAT ARE THE CHALLENGES? From disagreements on core purpose to divergent interests, BRICS is grappling with many challenges today.
While Russia and China consider the bloc a counterweight to the West, India and Brazil see it as more focused on economics and reform.
The 2024 expansion has also complicated its consensus-oriented approach, with divergent foreign policy interests hindering agreement.
This hurdle will come into sharp focus this week, as India seeks to strike a joint statement by bridging differences between Tehran and Washington-ally Abu Dhabi, which are on opposing sides of the U.S.-Iran war.
Their differences [USN:L1N41S0BA TEXT:"prevented a joint statement"] during the BRICS foreign ministers' meeting in New Delhi in May.
HOW DOES THE WEST VIEW BRICS? Most Western nations are cautious about the grouping, recognising it as a platform that can slowly shift the balance of geopolitical power, but the bloc has repeatedly clashed with U.S. President Donald Trump, who has termed it "anti-American".
He has also threatened to [USN:L1N3T50QB TEXT:"slap tariffs"] on its members if they try to set up a new BRICS currency, or back any currency to replace the U.S. dollar.
Brazil floated the idea of a common BRICS currency during its chairmanship last year but the idea was later scrapped.

items.title: Junior Caminero's walk-off homer beats Astros, sends Rays to playoffs
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Junior Caminero launched a mammoth walk-off home run in the ninth inning Friday night, sending the Tampa Bay Rays to the postseason by virtue of a 3-1 win over the Houston Astros in St. Petersburg, Fla.
items.body:
Junior Caminero launched a mammoth walk-off home run in the ninth inning Friday night, sending the Tampa Bay Rays to the postseason by virtue of a 3-1 win over the Houston Astros in St. Petersburg, Fla.
The American League's home run leader, Caminero crushed a 417-foot blast to left-center field off reliever Bryan Abreu (6-4) for his 40th long ball. One batter earlier, Jonathan Aranda nearly homered to right-center, settling for a one-out double.
Caminero then belted Abreu's 97 mph first-pitch fastball for his first career walk-off blast, making the Rays (88-59) the first club to clinch a postseason spot this year.
The Rays, the American League East leaders who can get no worse than a wild card, are headed to the playoffs for the first time since 2023.
Tampa Bay got a solo home run from Victor Mesa Jr., who also walked and stole a base. Richie Palacios recorded a single, a walk and a stolen base.
Drew Rasmussen drew a no-decision after seven strong innings, though the Rays won for the 10th consecutive time in games he has started. The right-hander allowed one run on eight hits with four strikeouts and no walks in 92 pitches.
Tampa Bay closer Bryan Baker (2-2) tossed a scoreless ninth inning with a walk and a strikeout.
Without star slugger Yordan Alvarez, who twisted his right ankle running the bases Thursday in Philadelphia, the AL West-leading Astros (75-73) still outhit the Rays 9-4. Yainer Diaz went 2-for-3 with an RBI and a walk.
Opener Miguel Ullola and Bryan King combined for 2 1/3 scoreless innings before Ethan Pecko took over as the bulk reliever. Pecko was sharp, yielding one run on one hit over 5 2/3 innings. He fanned four and walked two.
In the fourth inning, Tampa Bay left fielder Chandler Simpson misplayed a one-out liner by Isaac Paredes for a double. Paredes, a former Ray, went to third on Daulton Varsho's single and scored on Diaz's fielder's-choice grounder for a 1-0 lead.
After managing just one hit through four frames, the Rays pulled level when Mesa cranked Pecko's first pitch of the fifth for his 13th long ball. The shot to right-center off Pecko's four-seam fastball traveled 415 feet.
--Field Level Media

items.title: BC LB Bodie Kahoun has movement in extremities after serious injury
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Boston College linebacker Bodie Kahoun had to be taken off on a stretcher during the second quarter of the Eagles' game against Rutgers on Friday night in Chestnut Hill, Mass.
items.body:
Boston College linebacker Bodie Kahoun had to be taken off on a stretcher during the second quarter of the Eagles' game against Rutgers on Friday night in Chestnut Hill, Mass.
Eagles coach Bill O'Brien said of Kahoun after his team's 28-21 win, according to the Boston Globe, "He's just an awesome guy. You can see what that meant to the team. ... It looks like there's some hope there with the feeling in his extremities."
Kahoun made a tackle on Rutgers running back Antwan Raymond and remained down on the field before training staffs from both teams attended to him.
After a delay of several minutes, Kahoun was transferred via stretcher into an ambulance to be taken off the field. Just before he was loaded in, he gave the crowd a thumbs-up.
Boston College shared on social media that Kahoun "has movement in all extremities and is being taken to a local hospital for further examination."
Kahoun is in his first season at Boston College after spending two years at Notre Dame. He had six tackles Friday before his injury.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Australia's Optus apologises for outage that disrupted emergency calls
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Optus, Australia's No. 2 telecom carrier, on Saturday apologised a day after an outage on its network impacted users across three states and disrupted some emergency services calls.
items.body:
Optus, Australia's No. 2 telecom carrier, on Saturday apologised a day after an outage on its network impacted users across three states and disrupted some emergency services calls.
The 76-minute technical glitch on Friday affected Optus voice calling services in parts of Victoria, South Australia, Tasmania states and the Northern Territory, with some customers experiencing "intermittent call dropouts", Optus said in a statement.
"We sincerely apologise to customers for the disruption," the statement said.
The outage follows an Optus [USN:L3N3V800U TEXT:"network issue"] last year that left hundreds of people unable to contact police, fire and ambulance services and resulted in two deaths.
Chris Bowen, a senior minister in the country's centre-left government, said it was "deeply concerning" that another outage had hit Optus customers.
"All the necessary investigations have begun," Bowen said in televised remarks. "It's an obligation on our telecommunications companies to keep all their technology for triple-0 calls in the best possible working order."
Police in Victoria said they completed around 40 welfare checks on callers hit by Friday's outage.
"There were no adverse outcomes or issues of note," a police spokesperson said in a statement.
In 2024, Optus, owned by Singapore Telecommunications (STEL.SI) , was fined A$12 million by regulators for failing to provide emergency call services to thousands during a nationwide outage in 2023. Optus also suffered a cyberattack in 2022 that affected the data of around 9.5 million Australians.
(This story has been refiled to fix the grammar and the use of partial quote in paragraph 2.)

items.title: VinFast names founder's eldest son as its global chief executive
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Vietnamese electric vehicle maker VinFast on Saturday named Chairman Pham Nhat Quan Anh, the eldest son of founder Pham Nhat Vuong, as its global chief executive as the loss-making firm plans a restructuring and overseas expansion.
items.body:
Vietnamese electric vehicle maker VinFast (VFS.O) on Saturday named Chairman Pham Nhat Quan Anh, the eldest son of founder Pham Nhat Vuong, as its global chief executive as the loss-making firm plans a restructuring and overseas expansion.
Anh, 33, who was [USN:L4N4220IT TEXT:"appointed global chairman"] in May, will also serve as chairman and chief executive officer of VinFast Vietnam. The EV maker is planning to restructure into a more [USN:L6N41Q0P5 TEXT:"asset-light company"] as it seeks growth in key markets such as Southeast Asia and [USN:L4N44Z0QJ TEXT:"India"].
"Pham Nhat Quan Anh will hold ultimate and comprehensive responsibility for all of VinFast's operations as the company enters a new phase of growth," the company said in a statement.
Anh will succeed his father, founder Pham Nhat Vuong, as chief executive. Vuong will continue to serve on VinFast's board.
Anh will be VinFast's fifth chief executive. Previous CEOs include former General Motors (GM.N) executive James DeLuca, ex-Opel chief Michael Lohscheller, and Le Thi Thu Thuy, who led the company through its Nasdaq listing.
In May, VinFast [USN:L6N41R0QY TEXT:"unveiled a restructuring plan"] that would transfer manufacturing assets worth about $530 million to a purchaser group that would also take on about $6.9 billion in debt, as the automaker seeks to reduce future capital requirements.
The complexity of the deal and the involvement of investors with ties to Vingroup (VIC.HM) and Vuong has raised concerns for some analysts and shareholders.
VinFast reported a rise of nearly [USN:L4N42G132 TEXT:"42% in first-quarter revenue"] but posted a wider net loss. It has received ongoing financial support from Vuong, the founder and chairman of Vingroup, Vietnam's biggest conglomerate and VinFast's parent company.
Anh is a graduate of Singapore Management University and held a number of senior roles at VinFast and other Vingroup companies before becoming chairman of VinFast Auto. He will remain as chief executive of VinMetal, a steel producer within the Vingroup conglomerate.
Also on Saturday, Pham Nhat Minh Hoang, Vuong's second son, was named as global chief executive officer at VinFast-linked taxi firm GSM, with Nguyen Quoc Tuan appointed global chairman.
GSM is planning a Hong Kong listing in 2028, and [USN:L4N44T0CT TEXT:"plans to purchase"] around 1 million EVs and 4 million e-scooters from VinFast between 2026 and 2030.

items.title: Framber Valdez, Tigers send Rockies to fifth consecutive loss
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Dillon Dingler hit a two-run homer, Max Clark supplied a solo shot and the host Detroit Tigers pulled away for a 6-2 home victory over the Colorado Rockies on Friday night.
items.body:
Dillon Dingler hit a two-run homer, Max Clark supplied a solo shot and the host Detroit Tigers pulled away for a 6-2 home victory over the Colorado Rockies on Friday night.
Dingler socked his 27th homer of the season but his first since Aug. 6. Clark scored twice while Riley Greene contributed a single, a double and a triple while scoring a run and driving in two more for Detroit (68-79).
Framber Valdez (10-10) held the Rockies (55-92) to one unearned run and six hits in six innings. He walked two and struck out two. Kenley Jansen got the final out for his 19th save as Detroit won for the fourth time in six games.
Colorado starter Mason Adams limited the Tigers to one run and two hits in five innings. He fanned five and walked three as the Rockies dropped their fifth game in a row.
The Rockies had three hits and a walk while breaking the scoreless tie in the fifth but only pushed across one run. They needed an error to do it, as third baseman Kevin McGonigle bobbled Ezequiel Tovar's bases-loaded grounder. The Rockies left three runners on base as Hunter Goodman's bounced into a fielder's choice.
Clark tied it in the bottom of the inning, driving a fastball over the right field wall. The next two batters walked, but Adams got out of that jam with a double play.
The Tigers scored four two-out runs in the sixth against Mark Manfredi (1-2) and Nick Frasso to take a 5-1 lead. Gleyber Torres, who had walked, scored on Greene's triple to center field, knocking out Manfredi. Dingler then hit Frasso's first pitch over the left field wall. The final run of the inning scored without a hit. Clark was hit by a pitch, stole second and scored on two Frasso wild pitches.
Detroit tacked on a run in the eighth. Spencer Torkelson drew a leadoff walk and Greene followed with a double down the right field line to score him.
The Rockies scored against Brant Hurter in the ninth on Adael Amador's single, two groundouts and Zac Veen's RBI infield single. When Jake McCarthy followed with another base hit, Hurter was removed in favor of Jansen. The veteran right-hander struck out Connor Norby to end the game.
--Field Level Media

items.title: テニス＝ルバキナ、サバレンカとの大一番に「自分にプレッシャーかけない」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　１１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　１１日　ロイター］ - テニスの四大大会最終戦、全米オープン（ＯＰ）の女子シングルス決勝戦に進出している第２シードのエレーナ・ルバキナ（カザフスタン）は、ベラルーシ出身で第１シードのアリーナ・サバレンカとの対戦を前に、自分自身に過度なプレッシャーをかけるつもりはないと語った。

ルバキナは１０日に行われた準決勝で、第４シードのコリ・ガウフ（米国）に３─６、６─４、６─４で逆転勝利。前回王者のサバレンカとの決勝に進むとともに、自身３度目となる四大大会制覇に王手をかけた。

四大大会のシングルス決勝において、サバレンカとは過去に２度対戦。２０２３年の全豪ＯＰで敗れたが、今年１月の同大会では雪辱を果たし、１勝１敗とした。

決勝後の１４日に現在の世界ランキング２位から１位に浮上することが確定しているルバキナは「決勝戦だし、重要な試合。相手が誰であろうと関係ないという気持ち。ランキングも近いし、自分にあまりプレッシャーをかけたくない。もし決勝でうまくいかなくても、年末までに他の大会やチャンスもある。お互いを高め合えるような試合だし、改善すべき点もより明確に見えてくる。自分の限界を引き出してくれる相手と戦えるのは素晴らしいことだと思う」と語った。

今シーズンを通じて好調を維持してきた２７歳のルバキナは、自身を支えるチームについて、「間違いなく助けになっている。昨年はコート外でいろいろなことがあったけれど、今はテニスに完全に集中できていると思う。常に最高のプレーができるわけではなく、浮き沈みはつきものだけど、私たちはとても良い仕事をしてきた」と感謝を述べた。

items.summary: ［１１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１１日　ロイター］ - 国際サッカー連盟（ＦＩＦＡ）は１１日、モルディブ・サッカー協会（ＦＡＭ）のバッサム・アディール・ジャリール元会長に対し、新型コロナウイルス対策の支援金を私的流用したとして、サッカー界から永久追放する処分を下したと発表した。

ジャリール氏は過去、マネーロンダリング（資金洗浄）や横領、汚職の疑いに関する調査を受けて、暫定的な資格停止処分を受けていた。ＦＩＦＡは同氏に対し、１００万スイスフラン（約１億８８００万円）の罰金も科している。

現地メディアの報道によると、ジャリール氏はＦＩＦＡの資金を自身の口座に入金したことや、同連盟の新型コロナウイルス対策の支援金を使ってマンションを購入したことなどで、計３２年の実刑判決を受けて服役。モルディブのニュースサイト「Ｓｕｎ　Ｏｎｌｉｎｅ」は同氏が先月、医療委員会の勧告により自宅軟禁に切り替えられたと報じた。同氏は３月に一度、自宅軟禁に移されたが、世論の反発を受けて刑務所に戻されていたという。

ＦＩＦＡはＦＡＭの元財務・管理部長であるモハメド・アギール氏に対しても、「ＦＩＦＡ資金の不正流用を助長・隠蔽し、偽造文書を使用してＦＩＦＡ独立倫理委員会の調査に協力しなかった」として、１０年間の活動禁止処分と１０万スイスフランの罰金を科した。

また、モントセラト・サッカー協会（ＭＦＡ）のビンセント・カッセル元会長には、「職権乱用、組織的な利益相反、ＦＩＦＡおよびＭＦＡ資金の不正使用、ＭＦＡ職員の心身の健全性に悪影響を及ぼす行為」で、永久追放処分と１００万スイスフランの罰金を科した。同協会のタンディカ・ヒューズ元事務局長にも、「ＦＩＦＡおよびＭＦＡ資金に関わる不適切な取引を助長し、それにより個人的な利益を得た」として、１５年間の活動禁止処分と１５万スイスフランの罰金を科している。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１１日　ロイター］ - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）のサンズに所属するセンター、マーク・ウィリアムズ（２４）が肩の手術を受け、長期離脱する見通しとなった。米スポーツ専門局ＥＳＰＮが１１日に報じた。

ウィリアムズは１０日、左肩の関節唇断裂を修復する手術を受けた。オフシーズン中の最近の練習で負傷したという。

昨季はサンズで６０試合（先発５５試合）に出場し、１試合平均１１．７得点、８．０リバウンドを記録した。７月には残留に向け、全額保証の３年総額３８００万ドル（約５８億４０００万円）で契約を結んだ。

２０２２年のドラフト全体１５位でホーネッツに指名され、最初の３シーズンを同チームでプレー。通算１６６試合（先発１３２試合）に出場し、１試合平均１２．０得点、８．５リバウンドをマークしている。

items.title: Pemex battles fresh Gulf of Mexico oil leak
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Pemex is working to contain a new crude oil leak from a pipeline at one of its Gulf of Mexico facilities off Campeche, Mexico's Science Ministry said on Friday, in the latest spill to hit the state oil producer's aging offshore network.
items.body:
Pemex is working to contain a new crude oil leak from a pipeline at one of its Gulf of Mexico facilities off Campeche, Mexico's Science Ministry said on Friday, in the latest spill to hit the state oil producer's aging offshore network.
The ministry said the leak was detected on Thursday morning. It expects the slick to drift westward in the coming days and, for now, does not forecast it reaching the coast.
Authorities did not provide an estimate of the volume spilled.
The incident follows a [USN:S0N3XL0B0 TEXT:"major Pemex spill"] in February caused by a leak near the Abkatun field. Pemex was slow to acknowledge that spill, which polluted parts of Mexico's Gulf coast, and no full accounting of the environmental damage has been released.
In a statement, a department of the Science Ministry said it would continue monitoring the slick's path in case conditions shift.
A Pemex spokesperson said the department was handling updates on the spill.
Pemex operates extensively in the Gulf of Mexico, where its biggest producing fields are located. Many are mature assets tied to extensive offshore infrastructure.

items.title: After losing her father on 9/11, a young Yankees fan built an unbreakable bond with Derek Jeter
items.author: Amy Tennery
items.creator: Amy Tennery
items.summary: Brielle Saracini came full circle at her cherished Yankee Stadium on Friday, throwing out the first ceremonial pitch 25 years after her father's death on September 11, a tragedy that sparked an unlikely friendship with her childhood idol.
items.body:
Brielle Saracini came full circle at her cherished Yankee Stadium on Friday, throwing out the first ceremonial pitch 25 years after her father's death on September 11, a tragedy that sparked an unlikely friendship with her childhood idol.
She was 10 when her father, United Airlines pilot Victor Saracini, died when his hijacked Flight 175 collided with the South Tower of the World Trade Center.
The tragedy set into motion a sequence of improbable events worthy of a Hollywood film, as Saracini formed an enduring bond with generational superstar Derek Jeter and met her husband, whose father died in the South Tower.
"You're so happy and thankful for so many things that have come your way after 9/11," she explained. "But it comes at a terrible price."
Saracini and her now-husband Sean McGuire met two years after the attacks at a camp for children who lost a parent on September 11. They married in 2017 and he was standing by her side as she took the mound, wearing a jersey for the New York Mets talismanic catcher Mike Piazza.
It was perhaps the only circumstance in which the Yankees were likely to allow their bitter rival Mets blue-and-orange to be part of a pre-game ceremony. McGuire got to throw a pitch, as well.
"There are some things that are bigger than baseball. Everyone always knows that phrase, and this is definitely just one of them," said Saracini, dressed in the Yankees pinstripes.
She was also accompanied by Jeter at center field and at the post-ceremony press conference, where he recalled meeting Saracini after the attacks.
"As an athlete, it was the first time that I said to myself, 'Why am I even playing?'" Jeter told reporters.
"And then you had a chance to meet a lot of family members who lost loved ones, and Brielle is right at the top of the list... that's when you realize that our job was to win. At least try to give people something to cheer for for a few hours a day."
The two have kept in touch since, meeting up repeatedly as the Hall of Famer periodically called to check in.
"I actually had a battle with cancer," Saracini told reporters. "I was able to get a personal voicemail (from Jeter) wishing me well, telling me to keep my head down and stay positive. And the amount of times I played that voicemail, you know, in the hospital over and over, just being like, 'OK, I got someone in my corner'."
The ceremonial pitch was not up to her standards - "I bounced it," she would later tell reporters with a laugh. But the bittersweet moment was enough to make her father proud.
"My dad would probably open up by saying, 'I taught you how to throw. How did you bounce it?' And then he would give me a big hug and say, 'You did great, kid,'" said Saracini.
"He would also then immediately turn to Derek and say, 'Thank you for taking care of my girl'."
'LIFE COULD GO ON' The ceremonial pitch was one of several commemorations at the Bronx stadium, where the Yankees took on the Mets in a Subway Series steeped with added meaning.
The American pastime became a symbol of American resilience in the weeks after the September 11 attack, with the first sporting event in the five boroughs played between the New York Mets and the Atlanta Braves in Queens.
The Mets won 3-2, courtesy of Piazza's dramatic two-run homer in the eighth inning. Weeks later, then-president George W. Bush threw his ceremonial first pitch at Yankee Stadium on October 30, Game 3 of the World Series.
"When the nation started playing baseball again, to me, it was like life could go on," said Fred Houston, 75, a lifelong Yankees fan, who came to the Bronx dressed in NYPD apparel.
"It wasn't going to change who we are and what we do."

items.title: Saudis shut down oil pipeline as Houthis tighten grip on Red Sea shipping
items.author: Mohammed Ghobari, Eman Abouhassira, Yasmine Ghania
items.creator: Mohammed Ghobari, Eman Abouhassira, Yasmine Ghania
items.summary: Saudi Arabia has shut down its East-West pipeline after the vital oil conduit came under aerial attack in the widening Middle East war, threatening to send energy prices even higher.
items.body:
Saudi Arabia has shut down its East-West pipeline after the vital oil conduit came under aerial attack in the widening Middle East war , threatening to send energy prices even higher.
The world’s largest crude oil exporter temporarily closed the pipeline after a drone attack that both Baghdad and Riyadh said had originated in Iraq, where Iranian-backed militias operate. Iraq dismissed a military commander on Saturday in response to the attack.
The 1,200-km (745-mile) pipeline running across the Arabian Peninsula had helped Saudi Arabia to bypass a shipping [USN:L1N453039 TEXT:"logjam in the Strait of Hormuz"], where tanker traffic has slowed to a trickle due to the six-month war between the U.S. and Iran.
The Saudi Energy Ministry said it had shut the pipeline as a precaution. The line has been moving 4 million to 5 million barrels per day in recent months, amounting to 4% to 5% of global supply, according to ship tracking companies and analysts.
It was not immediately clear who was responsible for the strikes. Satellite images showed black smoke rising from an area of the pipeline south of Medina. The attack resulted in some injuries and damage that was being assessed, the Saudi Foreign Ministry said without detailing the impact on exports.
The attack came as Iran-aligned Houthi rebels in Yemen tightened their grip in the Red Sea, which combined with the Strait of Hormuz disruptions has put an energy squeeze on both sides of the Arabian Peninsula and sent global oil prices back above [USN:L1N45303L TEXT:"$100 per barrel"].
Four Yemeni government sources told Reuters that Houthis had seized the strategic island of Perim on Friday at the mouth of the Red Sea, in the Bab el-Mandeb strait.
The dual attacks reported on Friday — on the pipeline and Perim Island — could represent a dangerous escalation while diplomatic efforts to end the war have stalled.
In a post on X on Saturday, Ebrahim Azizi, head of the Iranian parliament's national security committee, said: "As long as the American side does not accept all of Iran's conditions, dialogue and negotiation are of no use."
Saudi Arabia [USN:L6N45308G TEXT:"has asked Washington for military help"] with the Houthis, sources said, at a time when higher fuel prices during the war have already exacted a political toll on U.S. President Donald Trump and his Republican Party ahead of November congressional elections .
The East-West pipeline was hit on Thursday morning in Saudi Arabia's Riyadh and Medina regions, the Saudi Energy Ministry said.
The dismissed Iraqi military commander had led operations in Maysan province, according to Saturday's statement by the Iraqi prime minister's office. Maysan province, which borders Iran in southeastern Iraq, has long been regarded as an area where Iran-backed Shi'ite militias operate and maintain influence.
Saudi Arabia has opted against retaliation so far following a request from the Iraqi prime minister, the Saudi Foreign Ministry said in a statement, though adding that the kingdom reserves the right to "take all measures necessary" to protect its interests. Iraq's government condemned the attacks.
Saudi [USN:L6N4530LR TEXT:"crude supply fell"] to the lowest levels in more than three decades, the International Energy Agency said on Friday, partly due to attacks on ships transiting Bab el-Mandeb by Houthi-linked groups.
Iraq responded by ordering the closure of the Shalamcheh border crossing between Iraq and Iran as a precautionary measure, two security sources told Reuters. The crossing serves as one of the main routes for the import to Iraq of vegetables and other food supplies from Iran.
The two sources said a wide-scale operation was under way to find those responsible for the pipeline attack.
COUNTERATTACK PLANNED If the Houthis gain control of the Bab el-Mandeb strait, their backer Iran could gain a critical advantage in its war with the U.S.
Yemeni government forces indicated they would try to retake areas captured by the Houthis — mountain fighters who withstood years of devastating Saudi airstrikes during [USN:L1N4520AW TEXT:"Yemen's civil war"] — in their lightning offensive this week along the Red Sea coastline.
Reuters reported on Thursday that the dramatic Houthi advance down Yemen's Red Sea coast came with [USN:L1N45307P TEXT:"direct guidance"] from Iran's Revolutionary Guards.
Iran told the Houthis last week to escalate their attacks on Saudi Arabia and promised more funding, weapons and senior officers to help them do so, two Iranian sources said.
Iran describes the Houthis as an ally but publicly denies giving them military direction, saying they are "not a proxy".
The Houthi military spokesperson, Yahya Saree, said maritime navigation remained safe for all shipping except Saudi vessels subject to a previously announced ban.
SAUDIS SEEK HELP Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman [USN:L6N45308G TEXT:"called Trump"] at least twice on Thursday to request U.S. military help in fighting the Houthis, two sources familiar with the matter told Reuters on Friday, confirming an earlier report by Axios.
Washington told Riyadh it was not willing to take direct military action for now but would help with intelligence sharing and targeting, the two sources said.
The White House did not address a Reuters question on any phone calls between the two leaders, but a senior administration official speaking on the condition of anonymity said Washington was in continuous dialogue with Saudi Arabia and the Yemeni government.
Iran is expected to meet with Gulf states in Oman on Monday to discuss the Strait of Hormuz, the country's Foreign Ministry said on Friday.

items.title: アンソロピックIPO、エヌビディアが最大1.5兆円投資検討－ロイター
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米半導体大手エヌビディアは、米アンソロピックの新規株式公開（IPO）で最大100億ドル（約1兆5300億円）の投資を検討していると、ロイター通信が報じた。アンソロピックのIPOは過去最大となる可能性がある。

事情に詳しい匿名の関係者の話としてロイターが報じたところによると、アンソロピックはIPOで最大1000億ドルの調達を目指しており、同社の評価額は約2兆ドルとなる方向。エヌビディアをアンカー投資家として迎える方向で協議しているという。

ブルームバーグは先月、アンソロピックがスペースXによる過去最大のIPOと同規模か、それを上回る規模を見込んでいると報じていた。

アンソロピックのこうした目標は、AI業界の有力企業がテクノロジー投資の構図を変えつつあることを示している。創業5年の同社は5月、企業価値9650億ドルで650億ドルを調達し、ChatGPTを手がける競合のOpenAIが3月に1220億ドルを集めた際の評価額8520億ドルを上回った。

エヌビディアとアンソロピックの担当者は、ブルームバーグ・ニュースのコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。

ロイターによると、計画は引き続き協議中で、変更される可能性もある。

原題：Nvidia Mulls $10 Billion Anthropic IPO Backing, Reuters Says (1)（抜粋）

items.title: Trump says he would be OK with China building cars in US
items.author: David Shepardson
items.creator: David Shepardson
items.summary: President Donald Trump said on Friday he would not oppose Chinese automakers building cars in the United States despite widespread opposition from U.S. lawmakers and car companies.
items.body:
President Donald Trump said on Friday he would not oppose Chinese automakers building cars in the United States despite widespread opposition from U.S. lawmakers and car companies.
"If China wanted to come in and open a plant to build their cars here, I'd be okay with that," Trump said in an interview on the Fox News program "The Ingraham Angle."
"Japan does it, but they hire our people. The big thing is they hire our people," he said.
He added that he does not want Chinese automakers to build cars in Mexico and ship them to the United States. "I'm not knocking Chinese cars," Trump said.
U.S. automakers have urged Trump, who is due to meet Chinese President Xi Jinping in Washington in two weeks, not to agree to allow Chinese automakers access to the U.S. market.
On Wednesday, U.S. Senator Elissa Slotkin, a Michigan Democrat, said there were "rumors that Trump is planning to allow Chinese cars to be sold in the U.S., as part of a larger deal he’s putting together. That would be a strategic mistake."
Trump called Slotkin's statement a "total phony rumor" and said he had kept Chinese vehicles out of the United States.
A regulation imposed by former President Joe Biden's administration in early 2025 effectively bans all Chinese automakers from selling or building passenger vehicles in the U.S. Washington also maintains more than 100% tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles.
Last week, a group representing nearly all major automakers urged Congress to quickly pass legislation permanently barring Chinese vehicles from the U.S. market.
The Alliance for Automotive Innovation, which represents General Motors (GM.N) , Ford (F.N) , Toyota (7203.T) , Volkswagen (VOWG.DE) , Hyundai (005380.KS) , Honda (7267.T) , Stellantis and others, called for passage of the bill by the end of December.
"Right now, Chinese automakers are dumping subsidized vehicles with connected software and hardware around the world," the group's CEO, John Bozzella, said in a letter to congressional leaders.

items.title: サッカー＝オランダ、観客席での花火使用で試合打ち切りへ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１１日　ロイター］ - オランダ・サッカー協会（ＫＮＶＢ）が、観客席で花火が使用された場合は試合を打ち切る方針で検察当局や司法・治安相と合意に至ったと、同国メディアが報じた。

司法・治安相はオランダ紙ＡＤに対し、「今後は花火が使われたら即座に試合終了となり、スタジアムにいる全員が帰宅するというルールになる」と述べた。

先月、レーワルデンで行われたカンブールとフェイエノールトのリーグ戦でアウェーのサポーターが花火を投げ込み、複数の観客がやけどや聴覚障害、目のけがを負った事件を受けた措置。

問題の試合では、アウェー席のフェイエノールトのファンが多数の赤い発煙筒に火を付け、花火を投げ込んだため、前半に約２０分間中断した。一部はカンブールのサポーターがいる観客席に向けられ、１発はフェイエノールトのＧＫからわずか数メートルのピッチ上で爆発した。

カンブールはその後、ファン５人が負傷したと発表した。

items.summary: ［１１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１１日　ロイター］ - サッカーのコロンビア代表ＭＦハメス・ロドリゲス（３５）が、同国のアトレチコ・ナシオナルに移籍金なしで加入した。同クラブが発表した。１０代で母国を離れて以来、初めてコロンビアでプレーする。

契約期間は２０２７年６月３０日までで、１２カ国を渡り歩いてきたハメスにとって１４クラブ目となる。直近では米メジャーリーグサッカー（ＭＬＳ）のミネソタ・ユナイテッドに所属していた。

ハメスは０８年にアルゼンチンのバンフィエルドに加入し、その後はポルト（ポルトガル）やモナコ（フランス）でプレー。１４年ワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）では６ゴールを挙げて得点王に輝き、世界的な注目を集めた。

同大会後には移籍金７５００万ユーロ（約１３３億円）でレアル・マドリード（スペイン）に加入。クラブではＷ杯と同様の活躍を続けることに苦しんだが、コロンビアを代表する人気選手であり続けている。クラブで通算２５のタイトルを獲得し、代表では１３１試合に出場している。
